visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an animated logo of a boy in the top-left corner. A man with curly hair and a man in a grey shirt are seen in a dark, metallic elevator-style room with sparks flying around them. (2) The scene cuts to a crowded elevator in a formal office building. People are wearing suits and ties, looking awkward and looking away from the camera. A close-up shows a red digital elevator display showing the number 40 on a silver panel. (3) A sequence of clips shows groups of men in suits standing close together in elevators. A graphic overlay shows a yellow silhouette surrounded by pink silhouettes. Two men in suits are then shown physically fighting inside a modern elevator with reflective walls. (4) An animated male character with black hair and a blue shirt appears, gesturing while explaining a concept. Diagrammatic lines and text indicate the distance of personal space. A small inset image shows a woman with a highly frustrated facial expression. (5) Multiple scenes show people in elevators: a man looking up uncomfortably, a group of people in a colorful elevator smiling, and a small cat entering an elevator. The lighting changes from realistic movie scenes to bright, flat animation backgrounds. (6) An animated logo with a smiley face is shown, followed by a clip of two people in an elevator looking tense. A meme of a brown monkey puppet looking sideways nervously is inserted into the frame. (7) A man in a green elf costume is shown pressing many elevator buttons at once. An animation shows a loading progress bar with numbers 5, 7, and 8. The animated narrator returns, holding a paper and pointing upwards. (8) A woman stands in an elevator looking towards the ceiling. An animation shows two white emoji characters looking at each other and then away. The animated character finishes his explanation with a question, and the video ends with a subscription screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 維思維. [Slogan]: 為什麼搭電梯會抬頭看？ (2) [Subtitle]: 你有沒有發現我們搭電梯時時常不自覺看向樓層顯示器？ (3) [Logo]: PACHINKO. [Variety]: 封閉、狹窄、還擠滿陌生人的空間. [Slogan]: 個人空間. (4) [Logo]: #TIMELESS. [Subtitle]: 受到侵犯，所以難免不自在. (5) [Subtitle]: 人的人私人空間一般是一臂的距離. [Variety]: 一臂. (6) [Subtitle]: 對親近的人可縮小到0.5公尺. [Variety]: 0.5公尺. (7) [Subtitle]: 對不喜歡的人可能拉大到2.5公尺以上. [Variety]: 2.5公尺以上. (8) [Subtitle]: 當私人空間被侵佔時，我們的本能反應就是想盡快脫離現場. (9) [Subtitle]: 為了緩解不適，我們會本能地尋找一個「焦點」，將注意力從周圍的人身上移開. [Logo]: WENTWORTH. (10) [Subtitle]: 樓層數字除了能轉移注意力外，還有一種「進度條」的效果. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the social psychology behind human behavior in elevators, specifically explaining why people look at floor indicators to mitigate social anxiety and monitor 'progress' to their destination. It uses a mix of popular movie clips, memes, and animation to keep the information digestible and entertaining.
